_comment: SITE IDENTITY — the one file a hospital edits to put its own name on the manual.
Every {{SITE.key}} token in any .html file (and .webmanifest) is replaced with
the value here at build time (build.mjs). The build FAILS if a token has no
matching key, or if any un-substituted token survives into dist/ — identity can
This checked-in copy is the GENERIC (CairnReady) edition: no hospital, national-
default numbers, and an edition note telling readers to localize before clinical
use. A hospital version (e.g. LRH) is a branch/fork that rewrites these values
and then works through the per-tool SITE CONFIG blocks — see SITES.md.
Clinical thresholds do NOT live here. They stay in each tool's marked
SITE CONFIG block, next to the logic that uses them and the citation for them.
title: CairnReady Emergency Manual
editionNote: Generic edition — not localized to any hospital. Every threshold, dose, phone number, and cart location must be validated and localized by your site before clinical use.
